info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Manage Event Subscriptions API
info.description: The Manage Event Subscriptions API allows businesses to effectively control their event subscription lifecycles within the open banking ecosystem. This API provides the functionality to remove existing event subscriptions, ensuring that organizations can maintain accurate and relevant event tracking. Typical consumers include financial institutions and fintechs that require precise event management for compliance and operational efficiency. By utilizing this API, users can enhance their system's responsiveness to changes within the banking environment.

delete.summary: Delete an event subscription by ID.
delete.description: This endpoint allows you to remove a specific event subscription identified by its unique ID. Once deleted, the event subscription will no longer trigger any associated actions. Use this operation cautiously as it cannot be undone.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details required to delete the event subscription identified by RES-100045. Ensure that all necessary parameters are included to successfully execute the deletion.

204.description: Successful deletion of the specified resource.

DeleteEventSubscriptionByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for deleting an event subscription.

DeleteEventSubscriptionByIdResponse_204.description: A placeholder string representing the response for a successful DELETE operation in event subscriptions.

x-endpoint-id.description: This header contains a unique identifier for the endpoint that processed the request.

x-runtime-app.description: This header denotes the name of the application that executed the operation.

bearerAuth.description: Authentication method using JSON Web Tokens (JWT) for bearer authentication. Clients must include a valid JWT in the Authorization header for secure access to the API.
